pitfall: Arp et al. (USENIX Security 2022) P2 label inaccuracy: normal alerts were counted as false positives without review
population: every RCA case of rca-pulse-stable-candidate whose trigger window lies outside the campaign span (first interval - 60 s to campaign end + 60 s): the normal alerts of pulse-stable-candidate
adjudicator: Claude (assistant that also built the system), not an independent human; reported as such
evidence_per_case: the RCA evidence tree: Tetragon exec/fork/exit and security events of the container in the 30 s look-back, process ancestry, connect/flow destinations, suspect ranking against the workload's binary baseline frozen before the campaign, declared exec probes from the pod specs (exec-probe-spec.json)

rule.suspicious: any of: a security operation other than a privilege drop at process start; a binary absent from the workload's frozen baseline (unknown_binary or novel_binary); a connection to a public (non RFC 1918, non loopback) address
rule.benign_probe: not suspicious; probe_only (Pulse 5.18): an exec in the trigger window and every exec of the case belongs to a declared Kubernetes exec probe
rule.benign_routine_exec: not suspicious; execs present, not all probes, every executed binary in the workload baseline
rule.benign_no_process_cause: not suspicious; no exec in the case: the alert has no process-level trigger (traffic, drift or in-process change)

verification: the adjudicator reads every case labelled suspicious or unclear, and a seeded random sample of 10 cases from each benign label (seed 20261022), and records agree/disagree with the rule label with a one-line reason
reported: counts and shares per label with Wilson 95 % CI
agreement of the manual reading with the rule
consequence: confirmed vs expected false-positive status of the normal alerts
limits: Tetragon policy scope (exec/fork/exit, selected security hooks and connects) bounds what can be seen; a malicious in-process action without exec, security hook or external connection would look benign
one case per container per 5 min cooldown: cases sample alert episodes
